content.text:
Some of factorio's settings are not stored in any config file on this server — they are read from the environment when the game starts, and the only place an instance can set them is .grizzly/env, at the top of the data directory. It is always there, often empty. Don't go looking for a config file for these: there isn't one, and searching for it is time spent on something that cannot be found.

Exactly these settings do anything in that file, and the rest are ignored: LOAD_LATEST_SAVE and SAVE_NAME. A line naming anything else is dropped when the game launches, so the change will look like it worked and won't have.

Read the file first to see what's already set, then change it like any other config file — one setting at a time — and restart to apply it. That restart self-guards: if the game refuses a value and won't start, the previous version of the file is restored and the server restarted automatically, and you'll be told. So a value you're unsure of is worth trying rather than talking around; afterwards, read_logs to confirm it took rather than assuming.

There is no supported way to install mods on factorio through this bot — no registry is wired up for it, so there is nothing to search and nothing to write. Say so plainly. Don't improvise an install by hand through the file tools: anything put there that way is outside everything that would otherwise check it and put it back. If someone wants mods on this game, escalate it as a feature request.

input.message:
I found the problem. Your server isn't stuck. It crashes right away and keeps restarting. The log shows why: **Pipe Tuner (pipe-tuner 1.0.4) needs another mod, Pipe Core (pipe-core 1.0.0 or newer), and Pipe Core isn't installed.** Factorio won't start with a mod that's missing what it needs, so it stops at that point every time. Your save is fine. The game just never gets far enough to load it.

The quickest fix is to switch Pipe Tuner off in `mods/mod-list.json`. Right now that file doesn't list Pipe Tuner at all, and Factorio treats any mod in the mods folder that isn't listed as switched on. I tried twice to add a line turning it off. Both times the edit tool said it couldn't find text that is definitely in the file. I didn't want to force it with a full rewrite, because I can't install or manage Factorio mods here and doing it by hand could cause more trouble.

I've passed this to a human. They can switch Pipe Tuner off to get you running again, or help add Pipe Core if you want to keep using it. Your other mod, Lamp Dimmer, isn't part of the problem.
input.reason: Factorio server is crash-looping (2 crash restarts so far). Log: `Failed to load mod "pipe-tuner": Missing required dependency pipe-core >= 1.0.0`. mods/ contains pipe-tuner_1.0.4 and lamp-dimmer_0.9.2. mods/mod-list.json lists only base/elevated-rails/quality/space-age, so pipe-tuner counts as enabled by default.
